comment: Original primitive shapes, Z-up metres, doors face -y. Read by tools/blender/mesh_defs.py, web/src/shapes.js and the Unity builder. Shapes: box {at,size}, wedge {at,size:[x,y,rise],overhang} (gable, ridge along X), cylinder {at,radii:[r0,r1],height,sides}, cone {at,radius,height,sides}, hull {at,size,bottom}. Optional shear {dx,from,height} then yaw (degrees about at). Deterministic, no randomness. Materials named glow or rune are emissive.

scale.comment: Real-world scale standard in metres. Meshes are authored at 1 unit = 1 m and placed at scale 1 (never enlarged to fill a cell). Mirrored by Core WorldScale.cs and web/src/world-scale.js; tests check all three.

propHeights.comment: Believable real-world height range in metres [min, max] of each mesh as placed (scale 1). Tests in C# and JS check every mesh against it; see docs/ART_DIRECTION.md.
